split_rationale: H3 is a longitudinal phenotyping question. It cannot be rescued by changing random seeds, cluster counts, thresholds, or exclusions after a stability failure; any new design needs a separately reviewed protocol before execution.

evidence_groups.pre_review_conclusion: Supports evaluating stability when choosing and validating a clustering solution; it does not justify post-hoc reseeding or outcome-guided selection.
Provides a representative ICU trajectory-phenotyping example, not a transferable cluster count, feature set, or clinical conclusion.

required_signoff: Longitudinal features, time zero, observation window, grid, aggregation rule, missingness handling, and minimum measurement support are fixed before clustering.
Cluster count and algorithm selection do not use outcome separation, and outcome analyses begin only after phenotype assignment unless explicitly descriptive.
The protocol specifies internal validity, bootstrap or subsampling stability, and external reproducibility criteria before execution.
A historical stability failure is terminal for that protocol: no post-hoc seed, k, threshold, feature, or exclusion change may be used to make it pass.
Any redesigned phenotyping protocol is separately reviewed and receives a new content-bound attestation before it can be run.
